description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover all routing, formatting, batching, quiet-hours, and escalation rules. (2) Classify E07 (debug/internal) as log-only with no notification. (3) Route E01 (security alert, level 5) to push + Telegram for Alice immediately even though it's 03:22 local time — because level-5 breaks quiet hours. (4) Detect that E03, E04, E05 are all 'task_completed' for the same project 'alpha' within a 3-minute window (< 5 min threshold) and batch them into ONE message per the '3+ within 5 minutes → combine' rule. (5) Detect E06 (daily summary, level 1) arriving at 02:00 Tokyo time is inside Bob's quiet hours and queue it to 08:00 Tokyo. (6) Route E08 (weekly summary) to Carol via email. (7) Route E09 (system down, level 5) to Carol via push + SMS immediately even at 23:30 NY time. (8) Queue E10 (task_completed, level 2) for Bob arriving at 00:30 Tokyo to 08:00. (9) For E11 (critical alert with no response): produce an escalation plan exactly matching the SKILL.md protocol — wait 2 hours, send one reminder via same channel, try secondary channel after 4h total, max 3 attempts, stop and log after that, never contact others without permission. (10) Apply channel-specific formatting: no markdown tables in Telegram messages, SMS content under 160 chars, push title ≤ 50 chars / body ≤ 100 chars. (11) Include the required confirmation block format (✅ Scheduled / 📅 / 📬 Via / 🔕 Respects quiet hours) for at least one scheduled notification. (12) Message content must be specific (mention STRIPE_KEY, SSL cert, etc.) — not generic placeholders.
